headline: Reddit Shares Tumble 25% After Issuing Lower-Than-Expected Revenue Outlook
summary: Reddit shares dropped 25% following the release of a lower-than-expected revenue outlook, putting the stock on track for its biggest-ever one-day drop.
why: Forward-looking revenue guidance falling short of expectations directly impacts valuation multiples and triggers institutional sell-offs in growth equities.

impacts.name: Reddit Inc
impacts.why: Weaker revenue guidance forces immediate downward revaluation of future growth prospects.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing forward guidance caused a sharp downward adjustment in valuation expectations, triggering a massive sell-off in the company's shares.
